purpose: Teach: 歳月/安打/口実/地検/回生/町並み/孔/陵

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、長い歳月を経た古文書の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura — you covered ancient documents spanning long periods of time in your paper, correct?
lines.style: Steady, curious. Warm teacher cadence — not testing, genuinely reviewing. Light affirm on the rising question. Eyes engaged.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、野球選手の安打統計を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually focused on baseball player batting statistics in my paper.
lines.style: Clear, direct response. Slight surprise underneath — she's correcting the teacher gently, without defensiveness. Respectful but honest.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政治家の口実発言の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you researched politicians' false statements and pretexts in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Teacher processing — she's double-checking her notes or memory. Steady, not accusatory. Warm curiosity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、東京地検特捜部の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I wrote about the history of the Tokyo District Public Prosecutor's Office.
lines.style: Calm but clear correction. She's not irritated — she's simply stating her actual work. Respectful directness, no edge.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 医学部の留年生の回生指導を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And in your paper you addressed the academic guidance given to retained medical students, yes?
lines.style: Engaged, following along carefully. Teacher voice — attentive, checking in. Not skeptical, genuinely tracking. Warm cadence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、古都の町並み保存運動を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No — my paper was actually about the historic preservation movement in old Japanese towns.
lines.style: Patient but clear. She's correcting again without frustration. Slight steadiness in the voice — she knows what she wrote, and she's kindly setting the record straight.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 皮膚の毛穴つまり孔の微細構造を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the microscopic structure of skin pores — you examined that in your research, correct?
lines.style: Reflective, still tracking. Teacher processing, maybe a note of gentle humor starting to surface. Warm but slightly puzzled tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、古墳時代の陵墓発掘を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, actually — I researched the excavation of ancient burial mounds from the Kofun period.
lines.style: Final correction, delivered with patient firmness. She's been kind about it, but this time there's a touch more clarity — she knows her own work. Respectful but resolute.
